_doc: Declared-intent ledger for runWarnCheck advisory gates (E4 ceremony detector, M15b #1943/#1949). Every runWarnCheck call site in scripts/check-all.mjs MUST have an entry here: either a dated promotion (promoteBy) or permanent:true with rationale. This is the dated-debt discipline of suppressions expiry (INV-31) applied to the gate roster itself — an advisory gate with no dated promotion is ceremony ('advisory-forever'). scripts/check-bypass-ceremony.mjs (#1949) enforces this ledger. The 2 pre-existing runWarnCheck gates 'orchestrator coverage (#1410)' and 'conformance' were resolved by owner decision OD-14 (2026-07-17): dated promoteBy 2026-10-14, same window as the seeded #1943 entries — neither is permanent.
